text:
Dana K.: Pinging folks 1 PR #5210 adds a tiny appendix on multi-KMS chaining and asymmetric-HSM notes for private/on-prem installs. Need a quick docs pass, a short Rust SDK fallback example, and an IPv6 dual-stack preflight note.

Ibrahim S.: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5210. Link-checker found a bad anchor in the network page: /docs/private/network#dualstack-check -> 404. Suggest /docs/private/network#ipv6-dualstack.

Docs Bot: link-checker: PR #5210 -> broken anchor /docs/private/network#dualstack-check. Suggested replacement: /docs/private/network#ipv6-dualstack.

Ravi N.: For multi-KMS chaining add a short example: primary KMS (cloud) with local fallback for air-gapped failover. Keep it tiny and ops-friendly. Also add note: when chaining, verify key IDs do not collide and sync HSM slot labels.

Dana K.: Draft Rust example (very small): ```rust
use rwinf_sdk::Client;
use std::env;
env::set_var("RW_KMS", "local");
env::set_var("RW_KMS_PATH", "/var/lib/local-kms/keys");
let client = Client::new(); // picks env vars in airgapped installs
``` Call out: test in staging VPC first.

Marta V.: Add HSM asymmetric note: if using asymmetric keys across model-signing and TLS, ensure PKCS#11 labels are stable across upgrades. Include commands: `pkcs11-tool --list-slots --module /usr/lib/hsm/libhsm.so` and `pkcs11-tool --list-objects --login --slot <id>`. Mention export of slot mapping: `pkcs11-tool --list-slots > /tmp/hsm-slots-$(date +%s).txt`.

Ibrahim S.: IPv6 preflight: include `ip -6 addr show` and an app-level ping: `curl -6 --connect-timeout 3 https://[fd00::1]:8443/healthz || echo 'kms v6 unreachable'`. Note: some clouds require disabling RDMA for gRPC over IPv6 in our tests.

Ravi N.: Rollback/rollback blockers: advise flushing model metadata before restore: `rwinf-admin cache flush --prefix=model:` and then safe restore: `sudo systemctl stop redwood-inference && tar -xzf /opt/redwood/releases/<version>.tgz -C /opt/redwood && sudo systemctl start redwood-inference`. Call out expected ~1min warmup.

Dana K.: Also include a short multi-KMS config snippet for the YAML installer (one-liner): `kms:
  primary: {type: cloud, endpoint: https://kms.cloud.local}
  fallback: {type: local, path: /var/lib/local-kms/keys}` and note the precedence rule.

Marta V.: Docs nit: replace "restart service" -> "perform a graceful restart" in rollback appendix. Fix the broken network anchor to /docs/private/network#ipv6-dualstack.

Docs Bot: automated-checks: please wrap inline commands in backticks and fenced code blocks for multi-line snippets. link-checker will re-run on push.

Ibrahim S.: I'll patch the anchor and add the Rust snippet + IPv6 checks. Will run link-checker locally then push.

Dana K.: Thanks 1 Ping here when CI/link-checker green and Marta gives HSM label export thumbs up. Merge after that. :shipit:
